item.text: The page currently reads cookies and headers directly in its main render, while project totals have no cache boundary. I’m moving member details into a streamed component, caching totals independently, and adding a static dashboard shell that renders before either section resolves.

item.text:
Enabled Cache Components and partial prefetching in [next.config.ts](/workspace/next.config.ts:3). The member name, team, and request region load inside their own Suspense boundary, while shared project totals use a separate cached function in [projects.ts](/workspace/lib/projects.ts:1). The dashboard frame and section placeholders remain visible while those sections load.

`npm run build` passed. Next reported `/` as partially prerendered with dynamic server-streamed content, and I found no route-level rendering opt-outs.
